conbody.p: AI tools can accelerate drafting, terminology checks, restructuring, and maintenance. They should not be treated as the source of technical truth.

ol.li: Use product specifications, API definitions, schemas, or engineer-confirmed information as the source of truth.
Use an AI assistant to propose a draft or identify unclear areas.
Validate technical statements, code samples, parameters, defaults, and responses against the source.
Have an engineer or SME review high-risk technical content.
Run documentation QA for links, terminology, formatting, and consistency before publishing.

conbody.note: SentinelGate is fictional. This project demonstrates documentation technique and does not claim production experience with a real AI-security product.
